# Aaron Sutherland for Newport City Commission

> Campaign website for Aaron Sutherland, an attorney and sitting Newport, Kentucky City Commissioner running for re-election. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

Aaron's priorities are safety (support for police, firefighters, and first responders, and streets families can safely walk and bike), transparency (residents see decisions about tax dollars before they are made), and community (parks, playgrounds, public spaces, and events in every neighborhood).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://vote4aaron.com/): Aaron's background, priorities, how to vote, and how to get involved
- [About Aaron](https://vote4aaron.com/#about): Biography and record on the commission
- [Priorities](https://vote4aaron.com/#priorities): Safety, Transparency, and Community
- [How to Vote](https://vote4aaron.com/#vote): Election Day details and the official Kentucky voter information site
- [Get Involved](https://vote4aaron.com/#join): Donate, follow on Facebook, or email the campaign
